question: Did Box's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue, non-GAAP operating margin and GAAP EPS come in above or below the company's own guidance from its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release in May 2026?
grading: Key points: (1) revenue USD 321.1M vs guidance of about USD 319M = ABOVE (+0.7%); (2) non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = ABOVE; (3) GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (FX impact cited); optional: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 = slightly above; GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% = above. Benchmark must be company guidance (May 26, 2026), which Box gives as point estimates ('approximately'). Fail if GAAP EPS is called a beat or the quarter is described as beating on every metric.
answer: Against the Q2 FY27 guidance in the May 26, 2026 release [H18-E1], Box's results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 [H18-E2][H18-E3] were: revenue USD 321.1 million vs about USD 319 million = above (+0.7%); non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = above; GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (the company cited a USD 0.04 FX headwind). Also: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 (above) and GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% (above).

output.answer:
## Bottom line

Box's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) results were **mixed versus its own guidance** from the Q1 FY2027 release (May 26, 2026):

| Metric | Q1 FY27 Guidance (May 2026) | Q2 FY27 Actual | Above/Below |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ~$319M | $321.1M | **Above** |
| Non-GAAP operating margin | ~28.5% | 29.4% | **Above** |
| GAAP diluted EPS | ~$0.11 | $0.09 | **Below** |

## Details

**Guidance issued May 26, 2026 (Q1 FY2027 release, "Q2 FY27 Guidance"):**
- Revenue: approximately $319 million (up ~9% YoY, ~10% constant currency)
- GAAP operating margin ~10.0%; non-GAAP operating margin ~28.5%
- GAAP diluted EPS: approximately $0.11 (including an expected ~$0.08 FX headwind)
- Non-GAAP diluted EPS: approximately $0.39

**Actual Q2 FY2027 results (reported August 25, 2026):**
- Revenue: $321.1 million, up 9% (11% cc) — **beat**
- GAAP operating margin: 10.2%; non-GAAP operating margin: 29.4% — **beat** (management noted this was above the 28.5% guide)
- GAAP diluted EPS: **$0.09** — **below** the ~$0.11 guide (Box cited a $0.04 unfavorable FX impact)
- Non-GAAP diluted EPS: $0.40 — modestly above the $0.39 guide

So revenue and non-GAAP operating margin came in **above** guidance, while **GAAP EPS came in below** guidance. Management emphasized the beat on the top line and non-GAAP profitability (CFO Dylan Smith: "we exceeded guidance across all top and bottom line results"), but on a strictly GAAP per-share basis, the $0.09 figure was below the ~$0.11 the company had guided.

- Box Q2 FY2027 results: https://www.boxinvestorrelations.com/news-and-media/news/press-release-details/2026/Box-Reports-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Financial-Results
- Box Q1 FY27 earnings deck (guidance table): https://s21.q4cdn.com/328470014/files/doc_financials/2027/q1/BOX-Earnings-DECK-Q1FY27-Q4website.pdf
- Q2 earnings call coverage: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/box-q2-earnings-call-highlights-230311410.html
